constraints.name: batch_origin
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((baseline_report_id IS NOT NULL) AND (current_source_run_id IS NULL)) OR ((baseline_report_id IS NULL) AND (current_source_run_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: parallel_preparation_source_required
constraints.definition: CHECK (((reference_report_id IS NOT NULL) OR (current_source_run_id IS NOT NULL))) NOT VALID

constraints.name: parallel_source_required
constraints.definition: CHECK (((reference_report_id IS NOT NULL) OR (current_source_run_id IS NOT NULL) OR (configuration_version = 'jev-multi-review-initial-v1'::text))) NOT VALID

constraints.name: reviews_ai_rating_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((rating >= 1) AND (rating <= 3)) OR ((ai_summary IS NULL) AND (ai_suggested_reply IS NULL) AND (ai_detected_language IS NULL) AND (ai_analyzed_at IS NULL) AND (ai_status IS NULL) AND (ai_error IS NULL))))

constraints.name: reviews_ai_token_counts_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((ai_input_tokens IS NULL) OR (ai_input_tokens >= 0)) AND ((ai_output_tokens IS NULL) OR (ai_output_tokens >= 0)) AND ((ai_reasoning_tokens IS NULL) OR (ai_reasoning_tokens >= 0)) AND ((ai_total_tokens IS NULL) OR (ai_total_tokens >= 0))))

constraints.name: reviews_attention_rule
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((rating >= 1) AND (rating <= 3)) AND requires_attention AND (requires_ai_analysis OR historical_import)) OR ((rating = ANY (ARRAY[4, 5])) AND (NOT requires_attention) AND (NOT requires_ai_analysis))))
